cards.text: King David is running from his own son Absalom (2 Samuel 15:13-14), and he's gone up the Mount of Olives barefoot and weeping (2 Samuel 15:30). Just past the summit, somebody is waiting for him. It's Ziba, the servant of Mephibosheth, Jonathan's son and King Saul's grandson (2 Samuel 9:6, 9).

cards.question: Ziba is standing there waiting for David. What has Ziba brought with him?

answers.text: Saddled donkeys loaded with food and wine
A band of armed men from Benjamin
A message from Hushai in Jerusalem

cards.text: And Ziba packed BIG: two hundred loaves of bread, a hundred clusters of raisins, a hundred summer fruits and a skin of wine. Friend, I'm in front of an oven all day, and even I'd look at that pile and say, 'Okay, SHOW-OFF.'

cards.question: David asks Ziba why he has all this. Ziba says the donkeys are for the ___'s household to ride, and the bread and summer fruit are for the young men to eat.

cards.text: Ziba's got it all worked out, even wine to refresh anyone who gets exhausted in the wilderness. Then David asks, 'Where is your master's grandson?'

cards.question: True or false: Ziba says Mephibosheth is staying in Jerusalem because he has said Israel will give him back his grandfather's kingdom.
David makes a decision right there on the road after hearing Ziba's report. What does David do for Ziba?

answers.text: Gives him all his master's property
Makes him captain over the guard
Sends him back to watch the palace

cards.text: Ziba says, 'I humbly bow before you…' Friend, he showed up with two donkeys and he's leaving with EVERYTHING Mephibosheth owns, like walking into a yard sale with a quarter and walking out with the whole house.
As King David comes near Bahurim, a man from the family of Saul's house comes out. His name is Shimei son of Gera, and let me tell you, he did NOT bring donkeys full of bread.

cards.question: What does Shimei son of Gera do as he comes toward David?

answers.text: Bows low and asks for mercy
Warns him that Absalom is coming

cards.text: Shimei throws stones at David and all the king's servants, even with the troops and mighty men right there on David's right and left. And he yells, 'Get out, get out, you worthless man of bloodshed!'

cards.question: Shimei keeps yelling. He says the ___ has paid David back for all the blood of Saul's house and handed the kingdom to David's son.

cards.text: Abishai son of Zeruiah, David's nephew (1 Chronicles 2:15-16), says, 'Why should this dead dog curse my lord the king?' I bet he's heard ENOUGH.

cards.question: Abishai wants to deal with Shimei. What does he ask David to let him do?

answers.text: Go over and cut off his head

cards.question: David answers Abishai, 'What have I to do with you, O sons of Zeruiah?' What does David say might be behind Shimei's curses?

answers.text: The LORD may have told Shimei to curse him
Saul's family may have sent Shimei out
Absalom may have paid Shimei to do it

cards.question: David says his own son seeks his life, so how much more this Benjamite. True or false: David then gives Abishai the go-ahead to deal with Shimei.
With the curses still coming, David hopes the LORD will see his affliction and repay him with ___ for the cursing he receives that day.

cards.text: So David and his men keep going along the road, and Shimei goes along the ridge of the hill across from him, yelling curses, throwing stones and flinging dust at David.

cards.question: True or false: When David and the people with him finally arrive, they're still full of energy.

cards.text: And there, David refreshes himself. Catch your breath with him, friend, because this story isn't done yet.
